item.title: Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical Advance Quantum Computing Work on EUV Lithography
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited (“Xanadu“; NASDAQ/TSX: XNDU), a leading photonic quantum computing company, has announced the next phase of its collaboration with Mitsubishi Chemical, a major Japanese chemical manufacturer, to advance semiconductor fabrication technologies using quantum computing algorithms.
